conclusions.text: DLA evidence supports the six-unit Vanuatu provincial tier and broad island-group identity; exact legal geography is not certified.

Pinned 2017 OSM-derived source identity, ODbL license and exact upstream LFS data object were reconciled to retained bytes, but the administrative-registry digest remains unreconciled because its generated cache input is not present in the baseline.
Current legal boundary-defining Orders, precise municipality exclusions and island completeness have not been established for any of the six subjects.
DLA ADM2 roster (71) and OCHA/SPC 2018 neighboring tier (66, blank license metadata) differ in apparent granularity; no verified crosswalk or provincial boundary inference is available.

methods.description: Load immutable pinned baseline and verify exactly six scoped IDs appear once in the indexed world partition, then check source native IDs and names and deliberate absent-ID/wrong-name negative controls.
Canonicalize source and Atlas MultiPolygon geometries using shared repository geography helper without repair; calculate intersection/union Jaccard and symmetric difference.
methods.distance_method: WGS84 inverse geodesic (not used in this area screen)
methods.software: Python 3.13; Shapely 2.1.2; pyproj 3.7.2; repository geometry.py and ellipsoidal_area.py
